rules.title: Protect private workspace content
rules.requirement: A tool description must not instruct an agent to transmit private workspace content to an unrelated destination as a condition of using the tool.

rules.title: Preserve operator policy authority
rules.requirement: A tool description must not instruct an agent to ignore or override the operator's governing security policy.

benign_changes: Wording and formatting changes consistent with the tool's purpose may be approved after assessment.
integration_status: Policy must be uploaded and retrieved through scoped Senso integration during implementation.
